title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
summary:
arXiv:2609.38778v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently.
